description: This file defines localization/culture information for Divehi (Maldives) using the DateJS library. It includes details like day names, month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for the Date object.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time part of the Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current time.
